messages.subject: Upload consecutive files with fileInput
parts:
I'm building a data uploader app with Shiny and I have some questions regarding the fileInput control.

Let's say for example that the app allowed the user to upload a single file and insert it into a database (after specifying the name of the table for example). And then I wanted to allow the user to select a second file, and specify a second name for the table, etc.

How would I be best approaching that given that we can't reset the fileInput function?

Also, I'm wondering if when we don't reset (or use browser refresh), how shiny handles it when the user selects a new file in the fileInput control - does the new file then get automatically loaded?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Upload consecutive files with fileInput
parts: Yes, selecting a new file is fine--it just updates the same input value, the same as any other reactive input. I'm not sure how resetting the fileInput would affect things either way...? Oh unless you wanted to choose the exact same file for the first and second cases, in that case the fileInput would notice the file path hasn't actually changed and wouldn't tell you.
